connectors.name: Left header

connectors.name: Right header
connectors.orderNote: No pin numbers printed; started at the end closest to the USB connector (bottom of image). Labels are printed below each pad.

connectors.name: Center 1x6 header (mirrored labels)
connectors.orderNote: No pin numbers printed; square pad not treated as pin 1 (rule 9). Started at the end closest to the USB connector (bottom).

connectors.name: Center 2x3 header (mirrored labels)
connectors.orderNote: 2x3 without printed numbers: position 1 at the USB (bottom) end of the column nearest the board edge (right column), alternating right/left columns. Square pad (CTS) not treated as pin 1.

uncertain: J1 grouping: the 5V pad sits in its own outlined box below the 10-pin left box; the mirrored 'J1' designator is printed under the 5V box. Recorded as one 11-pin J1, but the 5V pad may be a separate single-pin connector, and J1 may refer to only one of the two boxes.

Center 1x6 header label-to-pin mapping inferred: its labels are mirrored/flipped and there are 6 labels (DTR, RXD, TXD, 3V3, CTS, GND) for 6 pads with DTR above the top pad and nothing below the bottom pad; assumed each label belongs to the pad directly below it in the displayed image.

Center 2x3 header label-to-pin mapping inferred the same way (flipped labels GND/RI above the top row, DCD/DSR and 3V3/CTS between rows, none below the bottom row); assumed each label belongs to the pad directly below it.
notes: Single board-layout image (Seeed Studio, seeedstudio.com) with USB connector at the bottom; the product name 'UartSB' is not printed. Asterisks before D3, D5, D6, D9, D10, D11 recorded as printed. Skipped: FPC1 connector at top (pads not individually labeled), USB connector, TX/RX/PWR LEDs, unlabeled vias. Rotated color texts beside the center 1x6 header omitted per rule 6. Magenta marker crosses overlapping D4 and D12 labels ignored. Designators J1/J2 are printed mirrored.
